name: console-idle-backoff
title: 空闲 Console 派发退避并保留即时提交和停止唤醒
constraints: Isolated worktree only; no production operations, SQL, model calls or service changes
No weakening of complete byte/path/history checks or shutdown proof
rollback: Revert the code commit in an idle controlled deployment; retain every Operation, approval, Task, claim and workspace fact.
